findings.statement: SCN-VER-075 expects data.artifact.name = evidence-add-search; REQ-VER-011 impl requires evidence-<change>-<attempt> (1 without GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT). A test by the scenario fails any implementation of the REQ.

Replay base = merge-base(HEAD^1, evaluated commit). For MERGED the commit is M^2, an ancestor of HEAD^1, so base = M^2 and diff is empty; transition used merge-base(M^1, M^2). scope-valid, analyze-clean, factory-golden-passed diverge: honest SCN-VER-091 gets RECORD_MISMATCH.
findings.recommendation: For MERGED base = merge-base(M^1, M^2) as in REQ-VER-007; assert it in SCN-VER-091.

findings.statement: Replay does not say where record (classification), policy (packs, lock, warrant.json, .warrant/local) come from for effective_policy_hash. From HEAD: APPROVED/IMPLEMENTING of an impl-PR that bumps pack or reclassifies (4c itself) mismatch. From evaluated commit: MERGED mismatches, transition resolved policy on archive branch, not M^2.
findings.recommendation: Record, policy, L0 inputs = tree of parent of the commit introducing the transition (MERGED too); only R-21 inputs of MERGED from M^2.

findings.statement: Replay applies REQ-VER-003 waiver rule (expires_at not before today UTC) at CI time. A waiver valid at transition but expired before the CI run turns WAIVED into FAIL/BLOCKED: RECORD_MISMATCH on an honest record.
findings.recommendation: In replay judge expires_at against transition at; add scenario.

findings.statement: MERGED evaluated commit is head from its ref (M^2), then Ref requires PR merge commit = M and head = evaluated commit: circular. SCN-VER-093 (merge commit not M) has no independent M.
findings.recommendation: Define M independently: first-parent merge of HEAD^1 with M^2 = subject.commit of CI records in evidence[]; compare PR to it.

findings.statement: REQ-VER-007 accepts --by from roles of any approvals[] role; REQ-VER-011 requires merged_by in roles.maintainer and produced_by.id = merged_by. Approval by a non-maintainer role passes transition and always fails ci.
findings.recommendation: Check merged_by against the approvals[] role, or restrict --by to maintainer.

findings.statement: Replay asserts transition judged the committed tree, but REQ-VER-007 has no clean-tree rule: L0 gates read the working tree. Artifacts committed with the transition give RECORD_MISMATCH.
findings.recommendation: Require clean tree for forward transition (error with hint), or hint in RECORD_MISMATCH.

findings.statement: branch-isolated not recomputed, yet mismatch counts missing or extra gate; record has it. SCN-VER-090 expects no mismatch, text does not say how.
ci path rules spec/archive (docs, own waivers) diverge from scope-valid sets of REQ-VER-004: SCN-VER-073 shows scope-valid FAIL in data.gates; archive-PR docs before ARCHIVED fail warrant archive.
ci fetch: no error for artifact record failing schema or file name not equal to id.
archive: evidence[] of transition MERGED - new or any; a PR adding only ARCHIVED re-verifies old artifacts, maybe expired.
pull_request runs use the PR workflow: a PR without Change editing .github/workflows can drop warrant ci; SCOPE_VIOLATION for kind none is not enforced by that run.

assumptions.statement: effective_policy_hash covers classification from record and waiver layer (REQ-KRN-026).
